value.rationale: The invariant is not an arbitrary statistic: it measures chronological persistence of the seed edge as the central bridge in the simplest local-attachment model. The established 1/n asymptotic for an unrestricted two-hub configuration does not determine this seed-memory probability. The new upper/lower estimates identify a different sharp log(n)/n^2 rare-event scale and an explicit all-size influence of chronology, useful for distinguishing model seed-memory from global hub counts.
